description: A sphere of image tiles that spins on drag, brings the nearest tile to the front and shows its title and description — with autoplay and four shape presets.
interactionNotes: Spin the sphere with the pointer or a finger; the release velocity carries on with inertia and the nearest tile snaps to the front. Clicking the front tile only selects it; to open it or act you must provide `onItemClick` or `link` (otherwise no action arrow is rendered). The arrow keys move to a neighbouring tile and Enter fires the current selection; hover/focus pauses autoplay.

props.items: The tiles; each item has `image` (required) and optional `title`, `description` and `link`. The desktop demo supplies six local images with Persian titles.
props.count: Number of tiles on the sphere; 6 to 400 (clamped automatically).
props.tileSize: Size of each tile relative to the sphere radius, 0.2 to 1.2.
props.roundness: Corner roundness of the tiles, 0 to 1.
props.zoom: How close the camera sits to the sphere; 0.2 to 4.
props.pullBack: How far the sphere pulls back while dragging, 0 to 3.
props.stretch: Stretch of the tiles along the spin direction, 0 to 3.
props.autoplay: Interval of the automatic spin, in seconds; zero turns it off.
props.grayscale: Background tiles stay grayscale; the front tile is always in color.
props.dim: Dimming of the background tiles, 0 to 1.
props.intro: Play a short intro spin when the component comes into view.
props.showInfo: Show the title/description and action of the front tile.
props.renderInfo: Full replacement for the info layer; for a custom headline/action.
props.theme: Palette for the ink, shadows and shader placeholder.
props.inkColor: Ink color for the title/description; defaults by theme (`#fafafa` / `#0a0a0a`).
props.accentColor: Color of the action arrow; defaults to the ink color. The blue comes only from the variant doc.
props.backgroundColor: Root background; transparent by default so the card surface shows through.
props.ariaLabel: Group label when a tile has no title.
props.openLabel: Accessible-name prefix for the action arrow.
props.onActiveChange: Fired every time a tile settles at the front.
props.onItemClick: On the arrow or a click on the front tile; replaces opening `link`.

tips: All images sit in a single atlas and the tiles are drawn in one `drawElementsInstanced` call; no `three` dependency and no draw call per tile.

In RTL the title sits on the right (start) and the description on the left (end); in the narrow layout the info moves to the bottom-right and the arrow to the bottom-left, and the arrow is mirrored horizontally too.
Letter spacing is zero; any positive or negative `letter-spacing` breaks the joining of Persian letters.
Without WebGL2, a grid of the same images is shown instead of an empty canvas; the content and title are preserved.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the intro and autoplay are turned off; manual dragging and the keys still work.
For a lighter gallery, lower `count` and raise `tileSize`; for a dense mosaic, the reverse.
